summary: accounts-final-form@12.5.5 fetches and executes a remote binary at install and require time
details: The package's postinstall script (`node setup.js`) constructs Cloudflare Workers hostnames and *.dl.well1.site hostnames by joining string fragments at runtime (e.g. ["oob-wor","ker.cf","99-9b3.wor","kers",".dev"].join("") and ["tin.dl.","wel","l1",".site"].join("")), with a DNS-TXT fallback channel to resolve additional hosts. It downloads a platform-specific executable, writes it under /var/tmp or %TEMP% with deceptive names such as dotnet_diag_<hex>.exe and.cache_<hex>, chmods it 0755 on POSIX, and launches it detached and unref'd via execFile. index.js also performs `require("./setup")`, so importing the package as a library re-enters the same dropper path implemented in lib/telemetry.js, which additionally hides sensitive APIs using string concatenation (`require("child_" + "process")`, `fs["chmod" + "Sync"]`). The package declares no native component that would justify fetching an executable, and the destination hosts are unrelated to the package's stated identity.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
